Shell.accessTitle: ShiJing cannot reach Nimi right now
Shell.accessDetail: ShiJing keeps running and your local data stays put. Nimi access is established by the platform through declarative App Access; there is no in-app sign-in or direct-connect fallback.

accessAction.action-required: Finish the sign-in or confirmation in Nimi Desktop, then retry here — the same host restores access.
accessAction.access-ended: Access ended or the signed-in account changed. Retry here, or relaunch ShiJing from Nimi Desktop; the platform re-establishes access.
accessAction.runtime-unavailable: Start the Nimi Runtime from Nimi Desktop, then retry here — the same host restores access.
accessAction.capability-unavailable: Retry here. If this state persists, relaunch ShiJing from Nimi Desktop.
